query: INSERT INTO tracker_outbox(id,workspace_id,connection_id,issue_id,kind,fields) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,'fields',$5) ON CONFLICT(connection_id,issue_id) WHERE kind='fields' DO UPDATE SET fields=ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT field FROM unnest(tracker_outbox.fields||EXCLUDED.fields) AS field ORDER BY field),revision=tracker_outbox.revision+1,attempts=0,retry_at=NULL
